source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The selected landing removes only two line comments that suppress no-restricted-properties. Exact source comparison shows all executable text remains unchanged. Accepted source restores those comments, and the current Calendar-test rule still directs getDate use to getUTCDate. The shared Bug retracts the initial formatting premise and separates its later configuration repair. This is scoped maintenance evidence, not a new date or lint rule, and no lint/test result was produced.
title: The temporary Calendar lint-comment removal leaves executable test source unchanged
